paper.title: Structured Templates as Release Evidence
paper.abstract: We study how executable examples reduce onboarding friction for template engines. A small gallery of real outputs improves first-run confidence and gives maintainers a living release-readiness check.

findings.evidence: Users can run one command and inspect HTML, Markdown, and LaTeX artifacts immediately.
Each template embeds the exact CLI command used by maintainers.
The same engine can produce web pages, reports, board briefs, and scientific summaries.

methods: Pair every template with a minimal JSON context file.
Render examples during release validation into a temporary output directory.
Compare freshly rendered outputs with the checked-in canonical gallery outputs.
